project: The Stock Market: From the Ground Up
description: 80-topic source crosswalk across Foundation batches 23,24,29,30. Research references are not redistribution rights, complete claim-specific evidence, mathematical publication acceptance, or live product release.

records.title: Journal planned entry versus actual fill
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect defines execution slippage as the deviation between expected and actual fill prices.
records.sourceLimitations: The journal's pretrade snapshot and confirmed fill must be independently timestamped; a model is not a broker execution receipt.

records.title: Journal outcome versus decision quality
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect separates realized outcomes and return statistics from risk and performance estimates.
records.sourceLimitations: The quality of a process cannot be inferred from a single profitable outcome; the rubric is original training methodology.

records.title: Journal rule adherence percentage
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect research guidance distinguishes model selection and evaluation from individual trade performance.
records.sourceLimitations: The 18-of-24 checklist rate is an original hypothetical rubric, not a regulatory trading-quality benchmark.

records.title: Journal missing-data rate
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect notes absent fundamental data and shows how missing values affect selection filters.
records.sourceLimitations: Five absent fields out of forty is only a hypothetical record-completeness metric, not evidence of trade quality.

records.title: Journal realized versus unrealized P&L
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect distinguishes open holdings, unrealized profit and total net profit in portfolio accounting.
records.sourceLimitations: Tax-lot realization, transaction fees and mark-to-market price timing require a documented accounting convention.

records.title: Journal average holding duration
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect records order status and asynchronous fill times as separate trading observations.
records.sourceLimitations: Holding time assumes consistent open and close timestamps and excludes still-open positions in this example.

records.title: Journal trade grouping by setup
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect defines trading statistics from eligible completed orders and returns.
records.sourceLimitations: Grouping journal trades by authored setup names is a private taxonomy; none of these three outcomes verifies an edge.

records.title: Journal sample size versus claimed edge
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect research principles address bias, underpowered samples and overfit strategy conclusions.
records.sourceLimitations: Four wins in five hypothetical trades is descriptive sample frequency, never a future win probability guarantee.

records.title: Journal gross to net reconciliation
records.sourceScope: Investor.gov explains why commissions and other charges change net investment returns.
records.sourceLimitations: The illustrative $45 net gain omits spread, borrowing costs, tax basis and any charges not in the fictional record.

records.title: Journal planned risk versus realized R
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect defines profit and loss metrics and trade-level expectancy conventions.
records.sourceLimitations: Dividing an outcome by original planned risk is an authored R convention; missing costs or a zero denominator invalidate it.

records.title: Journal opportunity cost is not realized loss
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect separates actual portfolio positions and realized performance from potential alternative trades.
records.sourceLimitations: A stock's subsequent hypothetical rise is not realized P&L for a trade never entered.

records.title: Checklist pass rate versus prediction
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect universe selection illustrates filtering eligible symbols by declared criteria.
records.sourceLimitations: Three of four conditions passing does not satisfy an author-defined all-four rule; this is not a market forecast.

records.title: Trading halt journal reconstruction
records.sourceScope: Investor.gov explains trading halts and delayed resumption in volatile securities.
records.sourceLimitations: Reopening executions can gap past planned stops; this single fictional fill is not a guarantee of any broker behavior.

records.title: No-trade decision documentation
records.sourceScope: Investor.gov describes planning and decision checks before investing or executing transactions.
records.sourceLimitations: A recorded no-trade choice is an authored journal process, not an externally scored market outcome.

records.title: Pretrade invalidation condition
records.sourceScope: Investor.gov explains stop and stop-limit triggers and how an execution can vary.
records.sourceLimitations: The five-minute close invalidation rule is learner-declared, not an SEC-approved entry or sell signal.

records.title: Journal risk concentration across simultaneous plans
records.sourceScope: Investor.gov explains investment concentration and correlated exposures in diversification.
records.sourceLimitations: Summing three planned dollars measures stated gross budget only; overlapping market exposures may increase joint loss risk.

records.title: Daily realized P&L versus open exposure
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect portfolio documentation distinguishes holdings, net profit, cash and unrealized marks.
records.sourceLimitations: The -$40 realized result does not incorporate open-position profit; a total P&L metric requires a separate convention.

records.title: Learning retry versus graded retake
records.sourceScope: Investor.gov discusses the need to check transactions and learn before trading online.
records.sourceLimitations: Learning retries and preservation of an official assessment score are internal SMFGU rules, not Investor.gov policy.

records.title: Self-reported confidence versus demonstrated competency
records.sourceScope: Investor.gov distinguishes preparation and informed investing from the speed of online transactions.
records.sourceLimitations: A self-reported 9/10 confidence score is not a validated competency measure; the teaching rubric is internal.

records.title: Process improvement measured with consistent rubrics
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect research methodology emphasizes consistent evaluation and avoiding selection distortions.
records.sourceLimitations: Comparing 6/10 and 8/10 is valid only if both observations use the same original rubric and eligible records.

records.title: Scanner threshold and eligible observation time
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect's universe-selection API applies eligibility rules to declared observations.
records.sourceLimitations: A screening threshold must use the most recent completed eligible input, not a forming or future candle.

records.title: Minimum dollar volume filter
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect directly defines a dollar-volume liquidity universe and daily selection.
records.sourceLimitations: Shares times a single reference price is a proxy, not exact sum of executed price-times-volume transaction notional.

records.title: Share-float versus total-shares screen
records.sourceScope: SEC glossary defines public float in value terms using nonaffiliate held shares.
records.sourceLimitations: Subtracting an assumed restricted holding count is not the SEC public-float calculation; affiliates and timestamp matter.

records.title: Market cap filter and quoted-price timing
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect fundamental universe examples expose market capitalization and point-in-time fields.
records.sourceLimitations: A five-million-share times twelve-dollar market cap assumes a matching outstanding-share count and quote timestamp.

records.title: Relative-strength ratio versus benchmark
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect distinguishes benchmark-relative risk measures and ratios from absolute returns.
records.sourceLimitations: The two-index level quotient is an original relative-strength measure, not proof of benchmark outperformance in all windows.

records.title: Sector concentration in a watchlist
records.sourceScope: Investor.gov distinguishes diversified exposures and explains sector concentration risks.
records.sourceLimitations: Six of eight symbols is a count proportion, not dollar-weighted sector concentration or proof of correlation.

records.title: Volume filter and low-priced stocks
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect uses dollar volume as a liquidity measure rather than shares alone.
records.sourceLimitations: The priced-volume products are illustrative proxies and omit intraday trade prices, spread and executable depth.

records.title: Bid ask spread screen and minimum tick
records.sourceScope: Investor.gov distinguishes bid, ask and market versus limit execution outcomes.
records.sourceLimitations: A $0.01 quoted spread has different percentage impact at different price levels; tick regimes and quote quality vary.

records.title: Price gap screener with corporate actions
records.sourceScope: Investor.gov explains that two-for-one splits mechanically change raw price and share count.
records.sourceLimitations: An unadjusted -50% raw gap is not automatically an economic return; corporate-action timing and adjustment basis must match.

records.title: Premarket volume versus regular-session benchmark
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect explicitly separates regular and extended-hours data subscriptions.
records.sourceLimitations: Premarket shares and full-session shares have unlike time windows; a matched RVOL needs comparable intervals and venue coverage.

records.title: Watchlist candidate versus executable trade
records.sourceScope: Investor.gov explains that a watchlist price is not a guaranteed executable fill.
records.sourceLimitations: A passed price and volume screen is only a research candidate; a valid two-sided quote and eligible session are missing.

records.title: Scanner false positives from delayed feeds
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect describes missing and delayed vendor data and data-quality diagnostics.
records.sourceLimitations: The retained 10:00 quote must not be represented as 10:20 fresh evidence; actual feed SLA must be checked.

records.title: Watchlist ranking by composite score
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect documents customizable symbol-selection filter and ranking functions.
records.sourceLimitations: A weighted 68/100 score is an authored rubric; weights must be disclosed and are not a validated return prediction.

records.title: Missing-data exclusion from candidate score
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect warns that missing fundamental values can appear as NaN and require explicit filtering.
records.sourceLimitations: Imputing a perfect liquidity factor would bias ranking; the chosen complete-case HOLD is a disclosed internal rule.

records.title: Watchlist refresh versus price-alert trigger
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect describes the need to distinguish missing observations from valid price events.
records.sourceLimitations: An intrabar $30.20 does not meet a close-confirmed rule before the bar completes; alerts depend on chosen data granularity.

records.title: Volume acceleration versus raw volume increase
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect universe examples use volume alongside selection cadence.
records.sourceLimitations: Compare volume after normalizing different bar durations; one-minute 1,000 and five-minute 3,000 are not matched periods.

records.title: Breadth advance decline ratio and zero declines
records.sourceScope: StockCharts defines advances, declines and their difference in stock market breadth indicators.
records.sourceLimitations: An advances-to-declines quotient is an authored derived ratio; zero declines makes division undefined.

records.title: Breadth net advances versus percentage
records.sourceScope: StockCharts defines net advances as advancing issues minus declining issues.
records.sourceLimitations: Net +100 and a 50% advance count depend on a consistent 600-member universe including unchanged or missing constituents.

records.title: Market session filter and early close
records.sourceScope: NYSE publishes regular and early-closing trading calendars with exchange-specific times.

records.title: Duplicate ticker observations in scanner results
records.sourceScope: QuantConnect uses stable security identifiers for eligibility and universe membership.
records.sourceLimitations: Duplicate raw tickers can represent distinct venues or instruments; deduplication must use the correct symbol identity and timestamp.
